title: Which of a construction software company's six regional sales teams adds the most new paying customers in 2027, when two in five new customers are founded by project staff who left existing customers and one region's customers released a surge of them in 2026
subdomain: feature-adoption-diffusion-modeling (each region's 2027 new paying customers: organic acquisition plus the customers founded by users who left paying customers)
prompt_shape: a committed pick of one of six regional sales teams with its 2027 new paying customers to the nearest 200 and the region second, specialist hours by onboarding pod, quarter of 2025 and session kind (24), the 2025 new customers by region and starting plan (18) and the annual contract value they signed on each plan on the terms in force on the first paid invoice date (18)
